description: Fetch contract event logs (eth_getLogs). Heavy method: needs NODEFLARE_API_KEY or an x402 wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY) — costs ~$0.001 via x402.

chain.description: Chain to query. Accepts a slug (eth, base, arb, op, robinhood…), a common name (ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, bsc), or a numeric chain ID (1, 8453). Call list_chains for all valid values.

fromBlock.description: Hex block number or tag, e.g. '0x112a880' or 'latest'

name: get_logs
